title: docsrs-cli doctor success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command doctor. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms. Outer envelope ok mirrors data.ok (may be false with process exit 78 when checks fail; still a success envelope, not an error envelope). With --online, checks may include online_crates_io and online_docs_rs.

name.description: Stable check id. The offline run emits, in order: platform, http_client_posture, domain_types, error_model, unsafe_posture, web_fetch_posture, user_agent, config_dir, config_source, config_file, cache_source, dotenv_runtime, secrets_layers, timeouts, concurrency, retry_policy, disk_cache, rate_limit_dir, lang, user_agent_contact. Adding --online appends online_crates_io and online_docs_rs. There is no check named tls: the TLS posture is reported by http_client_posture.
